Add class hierarchy with superclasses (MEDIUM priority)

improvement_tracking.notes: The ontology is identical to iteration 1. No suggestions from the previous review were implemented. All identified issues remain unresolved, including the critical HIGH priority Critic class modeling flaw and missing convenience properties.

partially_covered.missing: Cannot directly query members at a specific time without using membershipStart and membershipEnd in SPARQL filters. Temporal snapshot queries require complex filtering.
Same temporal query limitation as CQ2 - requires SPARQL filtering with membershipStart/membershipEnd rather than direct temporal assertion.
No trackCount property on Album - requires COUNT aggregation in SPARQL over containsTrack property. Cannot answer directly via property assertion.
Requires navigation through TrackSongRelation reification (Track -> isTrackInRelation -> TrackSongRelation -> isRecordingOf -> Song). No direct shortcut property from Track to Song.

Critic class design is fundamentally flawed. Critic is disjoint with Person but requires :critic property to link to Person. This creates logical inconsistency. reviewText is on Critic class rather than on a Review reification linking Critic-Album-reviewText. Cannot properly model a person who is both musician and critic.
Requires navigation through PerformanceSong reification (Performance -> hasPerformanceSong -> PerformanceSong -> performedSong -> Song). No direct shortcut property from Performance to Song.

cq_coverage.details: CQ coverage remains unchanged at 80%. Nine CQs are fully covered through direct properties or simple navigation. Six CQs are partially covered due to complex SPARQL requirements or reification navigation. CQ9 remains the most problematic due to the conceptually flawed Critic class design where Critic is modeled as disjoint with Person yet requires a link to Person, preventing individuals from having multiple roles.

strengths: Comprehensive annotations on all classes and properties
Proper use of reification patterns for temporal and n-ary relationships
Consistent use of inverse properties throughout
Appropriate use of owl:FunctionalProperty where semantically justified
Existential restriction on Album class enforcing CQ15 constraint (at least one track)
Disjointness axioms between major classes prevent basic modeling errors
OWL 2 DL compliant - uses only allowed datatypes (xsd:dateTime, xsd:integer, xsd:string)
Proper directionality in all reification relationships
weaknesses: Completely flat class hierarchy - no subclass relationships utilized despite clear opportunities
No GCAs (General Class Axioms) for complex class definitions
No owl:equivalentClass axioms for necessary and sufficient conditions
Missing property chains for transitive relationships (e.g., City to Country via Region)
Critic modeling is conceptually flawed and logically problematic
No convenience properties for common query patterns through reifications
Limited use of advanced OWL 2 constructs (qualified cardinality, property chains, complex class expressions)
No defined superclasses for natural groupings (e.g., MusicEntity, GeographicEntity)
Missing explicit cardinality restrictions where semantically required
No transitive properties defined for geographic containment hierarchy

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Creating unconnected ontology elements - Critic class structure creates awkward disconnected pattern requiring bridging property
P8: Missing annotations - AVOIDED: All classes and properties have rdfs:label and rdfs:comment
P11: Missing domain or range in properties - AVOIDED: All properties have explicit domain and range declarations
P13: Inverse relationships not explicitly declared - AVOIDED: All object properties have explicit owl:inverseOf declarations
P22: Using different naming conventions - AVOIDED: Consistent camelCase naming used throughout
reasoner_risks: Low overall risk - ontology uses standard OWL 2 DL constructs compatible with Hermit and Pellet
Existential restriction on Album (someValuesFrom :Track) may cause minor classification overhead with very large datasets
No obvious inconsistencies or unsatisfiable classes detected
The Critic/Person disjointness combined with :critic property may cause instance classification issues if not carefully populated

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: URGENT: Refactor Critic class. Current design is conceptually broken. Option 1 (RECOMMENDED): Make Critic a subclass of Person, remove :critic property, remove disjointness. Option 2: Create Review reification class with properties linking to Person (as reviewer), Album (reviewed work), and reviewText (content). Current pattern prevents persons from having multiple roles and creates logical inconsistency.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Fix fundamental modeling flaw. Enable proper answering of CQ9. Allow persons to be both musicians and critics. Improve semantic coherence and eliminate logical inconsistency in the model.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add convenience shortcut properties: (1) :isRecordingOfSong from Track to Song as super-property chain of :isTrackInRelation o :isRecordingOf; (2) :featuredSong from Performance to Song as super-property chain of :hasPerformanceSong o :performedSong. These enable direct SPARQL queries without reification navigation.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improve CQ7 and CQ11 coverage from 80% to 95%. Simplify SPARQL queries significantly. Maintain reification structure while providing query shortcuts.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add :trackCount as owl:DatatypeProperty (functional, domain: Album, range: xsd:nonNegativeInteger) to directly answer CQ5. Can be derived via SPARQL COUNT but having explicit property improves queryability.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improve CQ5 coverage from 70% to 100%. Enable direct property-based queries for album track counts.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Create meaningful class hierarchy: (1) :MusicEntity as superclass of :Song, :Album, :Track; (2) :GeographicEntity as superclass of :City, :Region, :Country; (3) :Agent as superclass of :Person and :Band; (4) :TemporalEntity as superclass of :Performance, :BandMembership, :AlbumRecording. This increases hierarchy depth from 1 to 2-3 levels.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Increase quality score from 0.72 to ~0.78. Enable more generic queries across entity types. Improve ontology organization and semantic clarity.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add property chain axioms: (1) :cityInCountry as subPropertyOf (:inRegion o :inCountry) to enable direct City→Country queries; (2) :performedInCountry as subPropertyOf (:performanceLocation o :inRegion o :inCountry) for direct Performance→Country queries.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Simplify geographic queries. Demonstrate OWL 2 property chain capabilities. Enable transitive location reasoning.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add owl:equivalentClass definitions for derived concepts. Example: :ActiveBandMember equivalentClass (:Person and (:isMemberOfMembership some (:BandMembership and (not (:membershipEnd some xsd:dateTime))))). This defines active members as those with memberships having no end date.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enable reasoning about temporal concepts. Improve handling of CQ2/CQ3 through reasoning rather than SPARQL filtering. Demonstrate advanced class expressions.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add explicit cardinality restrictions: (1) Track should have exactly 1 (:isTrackOf exactly 1 :Album) - tracks belong to exactly one album; (2) Album should have minCardinality 1 on :containsTrack (currently has someValuesFrom, but explicit cardinality is clearer); (3) Performance should have exactly 1 :performanceLocation.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Stronger data validation. Clearer semantics. Enable reasoner to detect constraint violations.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Consider adding owl:TransitiveProperty for geographic containment if implicit transitivity is desired (though this may not be needed if property chains are added). Mark temporal properties (:composedOn, :releaseDate, :performanceDate) as having specific characteristics if temporal reasoning extensions are planned.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Minor semantic improvements. Enable potential future temporal reasoning capabilities.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Replace individual disjointness axioms with single owl:AllDisjointClasses axiom grouping all major entity classes: Person, Band, Album, Song, Track, Performance, Instrument, Role, City, Region, Country. More maintainable and comprehensive.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Cleaner axiom structure. Comprehensive validation preventing cross-type instance assignments.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add ontology-level metadata using Dublin Core terms: dc:creator, dc:title, dc:description, owl:versionInfo, dc:created, dc:modified. Consider adding rdfs:seeAlso links to music ontology resources (Music Ontology, DBpedia).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Better ontology documentation and provenance. Improved findability and reusability.

summary: This ontology is unchanged from iteration 1 - no improvements were implemented despite comprehensive previous review. It remains technically sound with proper reification, OWL 2 compliance, and 80% CQ coverage, but all previously identified issues persist: the critical Critic class modeling flaw (disjoint with Person yet requiring link to Person), lack of class hierarchy, no convenience properties for reification navigation, and limited use of advanced OWL constructs. Quality score remains at 0.72. The ontology needs significant revision to address HIGH priority issues, particularly the Critic class refactoring and addition of shortcut properties for CQ7/CQ11.
